fields.name: Timestamp
fields.notes: Microseconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z. Applies to every track in the frame.

fields.name: Track count
fields.notes: Number of 40-byte track blocks that follow (0..8).

fields.name: Track 0 Mode 3/A code
fields.notes: 12-bit octal ABCD packed 3 bits per digit (A in bits 11-9). Meaningful only when Flags.Mode 3/A valid = 1.

fields.name: Track 0 Latitude
fields.notes: Degrees, WGS-84. LSB = 1e-7 deg.

fields.name: Track 0 Longitude
fields.notes: Degrees, WGS-84. LSB = 1e-7 deg.

fields.name: Track 0 Altitude
fields.notes: Height above WGS-84 ellipsoid. LSB = 1 cm.

fields.name: Track 0 Age
fields.notes: Seconds since track initiation; saturates at 65535.
